subject: Closing a shiny app automatically after some action completes

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Closing a shiny app automatically after some action completes
parts: I want to redirect to the index.html file in my shiny apps directory after an action completes in a specific app. (e.g. a file is written).  It seems pretty straightforward in JavaScript but I am having a terrible time getting any javascript stuff to work.  The solution doesn't have to be JS, I just want to automatically close the app and redirect to the index page.  Any ideas?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Closing a shiny app automatically after some action completes
parts:
You can try the shinyjs package, there's a runjs feature:

runjs(sprintf("window.location.href = '%s';", url))
